sections.description: GeneratePress ecosystem abilities for MCP. Theme settings, GP Premium module status, GP Elements (full CRUD), GenerateBlocks settings, global styles (full CRUD) and Pro pattern libraries. Components are detected at runtime; abilities of missing components are simply not registered.
sections.changelog:
1.3.4

  • Security audit: SENSITIVE_PATTERN's bare auth substring was matching author/author_id field names, causing unnecessary over-redaction. Narrowed to authoriz — still catches authorization/authorized, no longer catches author.

1.3.3

  • CRITICAL: fixed a data-corruption bug — GP Element and GB global style content was not wp_slash()-ed before being passed to wp_insert_post()/wp_update_post()/update_post_meta(), causing WordPress's own unslash step to strip literal backslashes (e.g. JSON-escaped characters inside Gutenberg block attributes like globalClasses, corrupting block validation and generated CSS). Fixed across GP Elements and GB global styles. Theme settings/mods were verified safe and left untouched.

1.3.1

  • Initial public release: 39 abilities covering theme settings, theme mods, GP Premium module status, GP Elements CRUD, GenerateBlocks settings, global styles CRUD and pattern libraries.
